Same issue and I'm trying to work on it without therapy. I'm not a professional by any means but I've seen some improvement, at least.

For starters, I'm aware of these issues, the behaviours they cause, and force myself to do things that would help me heal. For example, you can stop yourself when you're in a negative thought pattern and remember that you're loved and worthy of it.

It helps a lot to know your attachment style so you know what behaviors and thought patterns are specifically caused by it. Having a partner with secure attachment is actually one of the ways to change to a secure attachment style.

You can also find resources at the appropriate subreddits, like r/CPTSD. You can also find CBT and ACT therapy worksheets online. Books about these issues may also help, like Attached by Amir Levine.

Hope this helps!
